name: Kittim
title: Son of Javan, ancestor of the coastal peoples
summary: Kittim was a son of Javan and is regarded as the ancestor of the peoples of Cyprus and the coastal lands in the eastern Mediterranean. The name is later used in the Bible to refer to sea powers and people from the west.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: Kittim is listed among the sons of Javan in the Table of Nations as the ancestor of the coastal peoples around the Mediterranean.
